build_model_v3det: build a deformable detr model config with 13204 classes for V3Det dataset training
create_train_pipeline: create a train pipeline with random flip, random choice resize, random crop, and pack det inputs
configure_dataloader: configure a class balanced dataloader with aspect ratio batch sampler for V3Det dataset
run_training_schedule: run a 50 epoch iter based training schedule with multi step learning rate decay
setup_evaluator: setup a val evaluator with multiprocessing evaluation and 300 proposal nums for V3Det
